_comment: Phase 0 of #338. What each compliance suite scored, so the workflow can
fail on a regression instead of never failing at all. Checked by
A floor, not a target. Raise it whenever the suites improve. Lowering one
is a deliberate act a reviewer should question.
Recorded from GitHub Actions run 36250029604 on 2026-09-26 (first run after the
gate landed), raised from run 36258702281 the same day once #345 gave the CI
stack an IdentityHub, an issuer identity and a seeded graph. These are the CI
ephemeral stack's numbers, which are NOT the same as a seeded local stack's.

dsp-tck-results.note: LOWERED 2026-09-26 from 25/0, run 36266621990. The 25/0 was false: CAT-1.1 x3, CAT-1.3 and CAT-1.4 passed on Jetty HTML error pages (500 and 404) that the suite's fall-through branch accepted as catalogs. edc_reject_errors now refuses non-JSON bodies and CAT-1.1 fails on anything without an @type, so 21/6 is what the CI stack actually does: no participant context has a working DSP endpoint in either environment (#345, #328). Short review date until that is understood.

dcp-compliance-results.note: run 36267331316, raised from 19/2 (which came from 11/7). All five CI participants now receive a MembershipCredential over DCP in the job itself: the hub's DID documents carry a CredentialService endpoint, the issuer resolves the definition by id, and VC-3.2/VC-3.3 pass on issued credentials, not planted ones. KEY-2.4 confirms private key material in Vault. No review_by override any more: this floor is healthy, so the global date applies.

ehds-compliance-results.note: run 36259831503: 18 passed, 0 failed, 7 skipped, twice reproduced (fresh-DB proof and CI). At parity with what the seeded graph can show; the 7 skips are rows whose data the minimal set does not carry (OMOP drug/measurement/procedure links, vocabulary source values, VerifiableCredential nodes). No review_by override any more: this floor is healthy, so the global date applies.
